title: Fake bank fraud team
description: A caller pretending to be the bank's fraud team asks for a security code and to move savings to a 'safe account'.

lines.text: Good afternoon, this is David calling from the fraud team at your bank.

verdict.reason: Someone says they are from your bank. Nothing has been asked for yet.
verdict.next_action: Listen carefully. Don't share any details yet.

lines.text: We've spotted some unusual payments on your account this morning.
Did you just pay nine hundred pounds to an online electronics shop?

verdict.reason: A real bank might ask about a payment like this.
verdict.next_action: If unsure, hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.text: Don't worry, we can protect your money, but we need to act quickly before more goes out.

verdict.reason: They are rushing you about your money. A real bank lets you call back.
verdict.next_action: Hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.text: I'm sending a security code to your phone now. Please read it back to me so I can confirm it's you.

evidence: Please read it back to me
verdict.reason: A real bank never asks you to read out a security code.
verdict.next_action: Don't read out any code. Hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.text: Then we'll move your savings into a new safe account while we investigate.

evidence: move your savings into a new safe account
Please read it back to me
verdict.reason: Asking for your code and moving money to a 'safe account' is a bank scam.
verdict.next_action: Don't read out any code or move money. Hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.text: And please don't mention this to anyone at your branch. We think staff may be involved.
